title: Hörmander's hypoellipticity theorem and the Rothschild–Stein theory
summary: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the regularity theory of Hörmander operators: second-order operators built from smooth vector fields X_1, ..., X_q (and possibly a drift X_0) whose iterated commutators span the tangent space at every point. It proves Hörmander's 1967 theorem that such operators are hypoelliptic: every locally integrable weak solution of X_0 u + sum X_i^2 u + c u = g with smooth data is smooth.
